name: Navas de San Antonio (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and grey, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Navas de San Antonio (a saint on yellow and the aqueduct on red).
history: The arms and flag of Navas de San Antonio were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 8 June 1993; the flag is barry of green, yellow and grey with the municipal arms in its colours over all at the centre.

features.role: Navas de San Antonio arms — saint on yellow and the aqueduct on red
